title: Talented musical genius Miquo releases a new track  "Sun Of A Gun."
htmlContent:
Miquo is a talented singer and lyrical genius who took his time to learn all about his craft to become the very best. Growing up around music-minded people, Miquo has made a name for himself in the music industry. The talented music star once again proves his worth with the release of his recent track "Sun Of A Gun."

Miquo's "Sun Of A Gun" is a dark tale of peer pressure and the need to fit in regardless of the outcome. Over a menacing and ominous backdrop of moody hums, eerie textures, and mellow drums, Miquo details the tale of a young man caught up in street life and the need to prove himself which leads to irreversible circumstances. The visuals are engaging and depict the story entirely, keeping his fans returning for more.
